generate_video_from_prompt: generate a short video from a text prompt using the AnimateDiffPipeline with a motion adapter
encode_prompt_embeddings: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings using the AnimateDiffPipeline encode_prompt method
decode_latents_to_video: decode latent tensors into video frames using the AnimateDiffPipeline decode_latents method
prepare_initial_latents: prepare initial noise latents for video generation using the AnimateDiffPipeline prepare_latents method
validate_pipeline_inputs: validate AnimateDiffPipeline input parameters like height, width, and prompt using the check_inputs method
